toefl.text: Minimum TOEFL of 600 on the paper-based test and 80 on the Internet-based test.
toefl.quote: Those students educated from a country where English is not the primary language will be required to possess a minimum score on the Test of English for Foreign Language (TOEFL) of 600 for the paper-based test and 80 for the Internet-based test.

academic.text: An undergraduate degree with an acceptable level of scholarship from an institution of recognized standing.
academic.quote: Admission to graduate standing in The Paul Merage School of Business is accorded to those possessing an undergraduate degree with an acceptable level of scholarship from an institution of recognized standing.

prerequisites.text: Introductory Financial and Managerial Accounting (two courses), completed or in progress at the time of application.
prerequisites.quote: The minimum coursework that must be completed or in progress at the time of application submission is: Introductory Financial and Managerial Accounting (two courses).

prerequisites.text: At least 6 upper-division U.S. accounting-based courses: Intermediate Accounting I, Intermediate Accounting II, Individual Taxation, Auditing, and 2 upper-division accounting electives, completed before the program begins in Fall.
prerequisites.quote: The following courses will need to be completed before the program begins in Fall: at least 6 upper-division U.S. accounting-based courses: Intermediate Accounting I, Intermediate Accounting II, Individual Taxation, Auditing, and 2 upper-division accounting electives
